review_method: Read-only source and cross-agent lifecycle review; source hashes are read from the frozen Git commit, not mutable working tree.

invariants.name: atomic selected-account refresh
invariants.detail: rememberLocalAccount expectedRecord guard compares identity, exact revision and persisted connection timestamp in the same SQLite write transaction; missing/replaced/revised rows fail without recreating a shortcut or advancing metadata. Null remains the fresh-registration API.

invariants.name: host identity and selected intent
invariants.detail: Navigation validates exact provider/endpoint/login/sender plus full catalog snapshot. Native/EWS call guarded rememberConnection and retain identity/session fences across async boundaries. Legacy directories without atomic capability are validated without unconditional metadata writes.

invariants.name: one local owner per transition
invariants.detail: New connection and account navigation wait for old restoration and owner cleanup. Failed owners remain identity-retained. Stale restoration does not close an already adopted owner transferred to an explicit transition, and does not silently retry its failed release.

invariants.name: strict observer release
invariants.detail: Observer handles survive cancellation failure; view replacement/new account work are blocked until explicit cleanup. Independent session/subscription drains settle before owner close. Per-view generation fencing rejects callbacks while retained handles remain available for cleanup.

invariants.name: ordinary Disconnect and Refresh
invariants.detail: Ordinary Disconnect cancels provider work immediately and uses strict observer/owner cleanup. Refresh/folder replacement cannot discard a failed observer. EWS Close and native Release expose explicit recovery.

invariants.name: first-cache-snapshot ordering
invariants.detail: Ordinary Disconnect starts observer-only retirement before awaiting restoration, so session.close can resolve a pending first snapshot. Failure is observed at creation; owner close waits for both restoration and successful observer drain. A failed first drain remains held for explicit retry.

known_behavior: SqliteStudioMailDraftStore.close memoizes its future, including failure. The native owner-locked executor releases its lease in finally; custom owners may retain resources on failure. Do not infer a persistent native lock from a rejected adapter close alone.
